about.title: Preserving Identity, One Story at a Time
about.description: For decades, the narrative surrounding Palestine has been dominated by conflict. Palestine Recorded (PalRec) is a web-based platform dedicated to preserving the rich tapestry of Palestinian heritage, culture, and traditions.
about.verifiedTimelineDesc: An unabridged record of historical events over a map layout of Palestine, supported by unbiased, verified sources.
about.communityTimelineDesc: A dynamic space where Palestinians and historians can upload media, testimonies, and proof of cultural history.
about.communityHubDesc: Share posts and interact via a dedicated messaging system.
about.reputationPointsDesc: Earn points for contributions that maintain the platform's integrity.
about.palGridDesc: Learn culture through a daily word puzzle featuring Palestine-related terms.
about.strictModerationDesc: AI and human moderators ensure history remains free of misinformation.
about.futureTechDesc: AI-driven chatbots to assist researchers and historians.
about.blockchainDesc: Confirming authorship to ensure legitimacy regardless of interference.
about.leadBy: Lead by Dr. Manar Abu Talib

seedPosts.author: Amr Bu-Gazala
seedPosts.text: Sharing a photograph from my family archive - Jaffa, 1946. My grandfather's orange grove before everything changed. We must keep these memories alive for the next generation.

seedPosts.author: Rawda Asfur
seedPosts.text: Today I visited the village my grandmother was born in. The almond trees she always spoke about are still there. Some roots cannot be erased.

seedComments.author: Layla Hassan
seedComments.text: Thank you for sharing this. History must not be forgotten.

seedComments.author: Omar Nasser
seedComments.text: These orange groves were famous across the Arab world. Beautiful archive.

seedComments.author: Sara Al-Khalidi
seedComments.text: The almond trees always survive. A powerful symbol.
